name: Pro Dashboard Builder
description: User-configurable analytics dashboard: resizable widget grid, KPI/line/bar/virtualized-table widgets, per-widget query builder, zod-validated JSON layouts and undo/redo.

props.name: data
props.description: Records every widget queries; filtering and aggregation are memoized per widget

props.name: fields
props.description: { name, label, type: 'number' | 'string' | 'date', options? } drives the query builder, metrics and dimensions

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on every committed change (resize end, edit, undo/redo)

props.name: onSave
props.description: Save button handler; receives the zod-validated layout JSON

props.name: readOnly
props.description: View only: no toolbar, no resizing

props.name: error
props.description: Render an error state instead of the grid

usage: Keyboard: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo/redo; focus a widget then Enter to configure, Delete to remove, Alt+Arrow to move. Resize handles are keyboard accessible. Use parseDashboard(json) to validate stored layouts server-side.
